rules.summary: Identifier references must resolve to an object in the same document. Validators must not fetch external resources.
Token alias graphs must be acyclic.
Brace token references must name a token declared in the document.
Timed intervals must end at or after they start. Clips must fit their timeline and must not overlap on the same track.
Entity parts, component composition, scene instanceOf and joint parent graphs must be acyclic.
State transitions must target a declared state.
A token alias must target a token of the same type.
Non-essential motion must declare a reduced-motion alternative.
A flow initial state and its transitions must name states declared on that flow.
A provenance path must be a JSON Pointer that exists in the document.
